name: Archaeological Sites of Bat, Al-Khutm and Al-Ayn
description: In Oman's interior, near a palm grove, Bat and the neighbouring sites of Al-Khutm and Al-Ayn hold some of the world's most complete remains of 3rd-millennium BC life. You can see settlements alongside necropolises, including the stone beehive tombs of the Hafit period, which still stand on the ridges more than 4,000 years later.
